preview.resize: area average to 128x96, centered on a black 128x128 canvas

selection.method: Visit plate rows A-P in order. For each row, sort its mock-control well IDs and choose one with a single Python random.Random(13) instance. Select site 1 and store fields in plate-row order. No selection depends on pixel values or measured compression results.

dataset.name: BBBC022 MitoTracker compression sample
dataset.reference_images: No matched higher-SNR images or repeated exposures were identified for this sample.

source.attribution: Sigrun M. Gustafsdottir and colleagues, Multiplex Cytological Profiling Assay to Measure Diverse Cellular States, PLOS ONE 8(12): e80999 (2013), https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0080999; Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection, Ljosa and colleagues, Nature Methods (2012).
source.changes: Selected 16 mock-control wells from plate 20585, one per plate row A-P, site 1, MitoTracker Deep Red channel w5. Repacked complete decoded TIFF fields as headerless little-endian uint16 without rescaling, cropping, filtering, averaging, or denoising. Each output plane is a separate field, not a Z slice or timepoint.

nfs_causality: No causal nconnect attribution or universal shard/chunk optimum.

readers.cache_policy: file-scoped client eviction verified with mincore; metadata and shard indexes warmed; server cache uncontrolled

plan.replay: 16 source planes repeated cyclically from plane 0; chunk edge padding is zero
plan.runtime_guards: Slurm limits, case process timeouts and cumulative allocation accounting; failures retained; no unrecorded retries

shard_count.conditional_extension: include achievable max54 only if the 30-vs15 gain exceeds5% after3 paired rounds, within remaining budget
shard_count.pairing: each round interleaves the fast settings and the two control settings; target16 reference before and after

shared_layouts.retention: one valid output per layout after metadata and full-plane spot checks; small preflight checks every value

primary_extension_decision.rule: median gain above5% and more than1200s remaining after round3

protocol.amendment_reason: The predeclared first-three-round rule did not select 54 shards. The completed six-round median gain of 30 over 15 exceeds 5%; a separate follow-up asks whether gains continue beyond 30. It does not change the primary selection or combine the new 96 GiB series with the primary 32 GiB series.
